propositions: Measurement context (environment, principal, privilege posture, instrument type) must be forced into the record as text to enable repo-grounded validation of contradictions between claims and infrastructure.

World-observable evidence (live IAM calls, cloud API invocations) cannot be audited by gates; privilege masking and simulator limitations can produce confident but unfalsifiable or wrong conclusions that survive existing review criteria.

Plan citations control gate scope and enable defect invisibility: assertions about unchanged behavior across config changes are undetected when plans cite configuration files but not the code paths that consume them.
Deterministic enforcement of measurement provenance declaration (no LLM) in the [operator-attested] contract mirrors existing det-first doctrine and prevents attestation without recorded context.

Four escape instances across one epic (wrong account, wildcard identity masking authorization failures, simulator answering wrong question, and uncited resolution paths) stem from the same root: evidence context is not recorded or validated against project ground truth.
